definitions.gloss: expansion and contraction, stretching and shrinking
definitions.explanation: The ability or action of extending and contracting. Used for materials, objects, and figuratively for flexibility in plans or rules.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゴム→ゴム：00073_gomu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{伸縮|しんしゅく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{伸縮|しんしゅく}{性|せい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
{伸縮|しんしゅく}⟦{自在|じざい}→自在：21493_jizai⟧な⟦ホース→ホース：25876_hoosu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{収納|しゅうのう}→収納：07497_shuunou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: A freely expandable hose is convenient for storage.

notes:
{伸縮|しんしゅく} means expansion and contraction, or elasticity. Composed of {伸|しん} (⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧, to extend) + {縮|しゅく} (⟦{縮|ちぢ}む→縮む：00027_chijimu⟧, to shrink).

COMPOUNDS:
- {伸縮|しんしゅく}{性|せい}: elasticity, stretchiness
- {伸縮|しんしゅく}⟦{自在|じざい}→自在：21493_jizai⟧: freely expandable/contractible
- {伸縮|しんしゅく}{式|しき}: telescopic, expandable (type)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {伸縮|しんしゅく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧: stretchy material
- {伸縮|しんしゅく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧: has good stretch
- {伸縮|しんしゅく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧: is stretchy/elastic

DOMAINS:
Frequently appears in product descriptions — clothing fabrics, expandable poles, telescopic umbrellas, stretch bands, and similar items. Also used in science contexts for the expansion and contraction of materials due to temperature changes.
